evidence_requirements.description: Minimum evidence required for LIVE promotion approval. All items must be satisfied and attached to the promotion record before go-live sign-off.
required: release_evidence_snapshot: GET /admin/release-evidence (requires ADMIN_API_KEY via X-Admin-Key or an approved admin token) must show runtime_ready=true, schema_guard.status=ok, startup_recovery.status=ok, and no synthetic_contamination. position_authority_restored must be true when existing position records were restored; a fresh database with zero records is acceptable only if /readyz is otherwise healthy and the empty-state evidence is attached.
smoke_test_summary: pytest -m smoke exit-code 0. Fast pre-deploy gate (< 30s). Attach output or CI artefact link.
test_run_summary: pytest exit-code 0 with no newly-introduced failures. Attach output or CI artefact link.
commit_hash: The exact git commit SHA deployed, traceable to the build artefact.

operator_checklist: Confirm CAPITAL_LIMITS_JSON contains funded-account-specific limits (not helper-derived generic defaults), TRADE_MODE=LIVE, broker secrets injected via Postgres broker_credentials or an approved secret manager, platform secrets injected from the operator secret store, and LIVE_PG_SSL_SKIP_CHECK absent for remote Postgres.
evidence_requirements.note: Tests are excluded from the promotion bundle (see excluded_prefixes). Validation evidence must be attached as a separate companion artefact or CI record.
